record.reason: The paper studies inference-time refinement steps and best-of-K search in masked-diffusion text-to-speech, evaluating intelligibility and speaker identity over model sizes and step budgets. It finds the two compute sources help different capabilities. This is speech synthesis rather than LLM/VLM inference, and the linked reasoning-compute family is only an analogy; retain borderline.
record.title: Refinement Buys Intelligibility, Search Buys Identity: What Test-Time Compute Buys in Masked-Diffusion TTS
